metadata.venue: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri

ai_summary.key_headline: Messi-led Albiceleste Brace for Desert Foxes' Aggressive Counter

argentina.philosophy: Positional overload with fluid movement around Lionel Messi.

algeria.philosophy: Compact defensive block with quick direct counters through Amoura and Gouiri.

tactical_insights: Argentina's possession will focus on overloads to free Messi in the half-spaces on his record sixth World Cup.
Algeria will look to exploit spaces behind Argentina's attacking fullbacks via Amoura's pace on the counter.
Mac Allister's ball recovery rate will be critical in stopping Algeria's central counter-attacking transitions.
